import bpy

Collection = "Test"

class ActionOperator1(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_1"
    bl_label = "Copy Bone"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
        bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action="SELECT")
        bpy.ops.armature.duplicate()
        bone = bpy.context.selected_editable_bones
        for b in bone:
            b.name = "SPIK bone" + ".001"
        bpy.ops.armature.hide(unselected=True)
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator2(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_2"
    bl_label = "Action 2"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.armature.reveal()
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator3(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_3"
    bl_label = "Action 3"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.object.armature_add()
        armature = bpy.context.object
        
        armature.name = "TestArm"

        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
        armature.data.edit_bones.remove(armature.data.edit_bones[0])

        bone1 = armature.data.edit_bones.new("Dress_FK_L.001")
        bone1.head = (0, 0, 0)
        bone1.tail = (0, 0, 1)

        bone2 = armature.data.edit_bones.new("Dress_FK_L.002")
        bone2.head = (0, 0, 1)
        bone2.tail = (0, 0, 2)
        bone2.parent = bone1
        bone2.use_connect = True

        bone3 = armature.data.edit_bones.new("Dress_FK_L.003")
        bone3.head = (0, 0, 2)
        bone3.tail = (0, 0, 3)
        bone3.parent = bone2
        bone3.use_connect = True
        
        bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='SELECT')
        bpy.ops.armature.collection_assign()
        bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='DESELECT')

        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
        
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator4(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_4"
    bl_label = "Bone Curve"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="POSE")
        bpy.ops.pose.select_all(action="SELECT")
        selection_names = bpy.context.selected_pose_bones

        if len(selection_names) < 2:
            self.report({"WARNING"}, "Please select at least two bones.")
            return {"CANCELLED"}

        startingPt = selection_names[0].head
        endingPt = selection_names[-1].tail
        midPt = (startingPt + endingPt) / 2

        diff = midPt - startingPt

        vertices = [startingPt, midPt, endingPt]
        edges = [(0, 1), (1, 2)]
        faces = []

        objectName = selection_names[0].name.replace("SPIK", "spline")
        RigName = "TestArm"

        for i in selection_names:
            for c in i.constraints:
                i.constraints.remove(c)

        new_mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(objectName)
        new_mesh.from_pydata(vertices, edges, faces)
        new_object = bpy.data.objects.new(objectName, new_mesh)
        bpy.data.collections["Test"].objects.link(new_object)
        
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        bpy.data.objects[objectName].select_set(state=True)
        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active =  bpy.data.objects[objectName]
        
        bpy.ops.object.convert(target='CURVE')
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
        bpy.ops.curve.spline_type_set(type='NURBS')
        bpy.context.object.data.splines[0].order_u = 3
        bpy.context.object.data.splines[0].use_endpoint_u = True
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
        
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        bpy.data.objects[RigName].select_set(state=True)
        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
        
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'POSE')
        lastBone = selection_names[-1]
        bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.bones.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName].pose.bones[lastBone.name].bone
        bpy.ops.pose.constraint_add(type='SPLINE_IK')
        bpy.context.object.pose.bones[lastBone.name].constraints["Spline IK"].chain_count = len(selection_names)
        bpy.context.object.pose.bones[lastBone.name].constraints["Spline IK"].target = bpy.data.objects[objectName]
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
        
        bpy.ops.armature.move_to_collection(collection_index=0)
        
        bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        
        newBoneName = objectName.replace("spline","SPIKCTRL")+".001"
        theBone = bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.edit_bones.new(newBoneName)
        theBone.head = startingPt
        theBone.tail = midPt
        #theBone.roll = theRoll
        
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
        bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.bones.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName].pose.bones[newBoneName].bone
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
        
        parent_bone = bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.edit_bones[0]
        bpy.context.active_bone.length = bpy.context.active_bone.length/2
        
        bpy.ops.armature.duplicate_move(TRANSFORM_OT_translate={"value":diff})
        bpy.ops.armature.duplicate_move(TRANSFORM_OT_translate={"value":diff})
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='POSE')
        
        context.scene.object_name = objectName
        context.scene.rig_name = RigName

        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator5(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_5"
    bl_label = "Action 5"

    def execute(self, context):
        objectName = context.scene.object_name
        RigName = context.scene.rig_name
        
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
        
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        bpy.data.objects[objectName].select_set(True)
        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = bpy.data.objects[objectName]
        
        x=0
        while x<3:
            bpy.ops.object.modifier_add(type='HOOK')
            hookName = "hook.00"+str(x+1)
            bpy.context.object.modifiers["Hook"].name =hookName
        
            if(x==0):
                bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
                bpy.ops.curve.select_all(action='DESELECT')
                bpy.ops.curve.de_select_first()
            if(x==1):
                bpy.ops.curve.select_next()
                bpy.ops.curve.de_select_first()
            if(x==2):
                bpy.ops.curve.select_all(action='DESELECT')
                bpy.ops.curve.de_select_last()
            
            bpy.ops.object.hook_assign(modifier=hookName)
            bpy.context.object.modifiers[hookName].object = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
            boneName = bpy.data.objects[objectName].name.replace("spline","SPIKCTRL")+".00"+str(x+1)
            bpy.context.object.modifiers[hookName].subtarget = boneName
            
            x=x+1
        
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator6(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_6"
    bl_label = "Action 6"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
        bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='SELECT')
        theList = [bone.name for bone in bpy.context.selected_editable_bones]
        Collections=bpy.context.object.data.collections
        for col_name in ["FK_LRY", "SPIK", "SPIK_CTRL"]:
            if col_name not in Collections:
                Collections.new(name=col_name)
        Collections.active=Collections["FK_LRY"]
        bpy.ops.armature.collection_assign()
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator7(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_7"
    bl_label = "Action 7"

    def execute(self, context):
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
        bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator8(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_8"
    bl_label = "Action 8"

    def execute(self, context):
        self.report({"INFO"}, "Action 8 executed!")
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionOperator9(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "object.action_operator_9"
    bl_label = "Action 9"

    def execute(self, context):
        self.report({"INFO"}, "Action 9 executed!")
        return {"FINISHED"}


class ActionPanel(bpy.types.Panel):
    bl_label = "Actions"
    bl_idname = "OBJECT_PT_action_panel"
    bl_space_type = "VIEW_3D"
    bl_region_type = "UI"
    bl_category = "Act Tools"

    def draw(self, context):
        layout = self.layout

        layout.operator("object.action_operator_1", text="Duplicate Bone")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_2", text="Reveal")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_3", text="Generate Bone")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_4", text="Bone Curve")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_5", text="Add Hook")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_6", text="Add Collection")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_7", text="Delete All")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_8", text="Action 8")
        layout.operator("object.action_operator_9", text="Action 9")


classes = [
    ActionOperator1,
    ActionOperator2,
    ActionOperator3,
    ActionOperator4,
    ActionOperator5,
    ActionOperator6,
    ActionOperator7,
    ActionOperator8,
    ActionOperator9,
    ActionPanel,
]


def register():
    bpy.types.Scene.object_name = bpy.props.StringProperty()
    bpy.types.Scene.rig_name = bpy.props.StringProperty()
    for cls in classes:
        bpy.utils.register_class(cls)


def unregister():
    del bpy.types.Scene.object_name
    del bpy.types.Scene.rig_name
    for cls in reversed(classes):
        bpy.utils.unregister_class(cls)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    register()

import bpy

# 获取当前选中的对象
obj = bpy.context.object

if obj and obj.type == 'ARMATURE':
    # 确保进入姿势模式
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='POSE')

    # 遍历所有选中的骨骼
    for bone in bpy.context.selected_pose_bones:
        # 遍历骨骼的约束列表，删除所有约束
        while bone.constraints:
            bone.constraints.remove(bone.constraints[0])  # 每次删除第一个约束，直到清空

    print("所有选中骨骼的约束已删除！")

import bpy

#Variables#
FK_bone_label = "FK"
RigName = "Dress"
Collection = "IK_Spline"
custom_shape = bpy.data.objects.get("SPIK_CTRL_SHAPE")
theList = []

#Collection Manage
#bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
#bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='SELECT')
theList = [bone.name for bone in bpy.context.selected_editable_bones]
Collections=bpy.context.object.data.collections
for col_name in ["FK_Dress", "SPIK", "SPIK_CTRL"]:
    if col_name not in Collections:
        Collections.new(name=col_name)
Collections.active=Collections["FK_Dress"]
bpy.ops.armature.collection_assign()

#SPIK Bone Setup
bpy.ops.armature.duplicate()
bpy.ops.armature.collection_unassign()
bone = bpy.context.selected_editable_bones
for b in bone:
    b.name = b.basename.replace(FK_bone_label, "SPIK")+".001"
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="POSE")
Collections.active=Collections["SPIK"]
bpy.ops.armature.collection_assign()
Collections["SPIK"].is_solo = True

#Ctrl Bone Standby
selection_names = bpy.context.selected_pose_bones
startingPt = selection_names[0].head
endingPt = selection_names[-1].tail
midPt = (startingPt + endingPt) / 2
diff = midPt - startingPt
vertices = [startingPt, midPt, endingPt]
edges = [(0, 1), (1, 2)]
for i in selection_names:
    for c in i.constraints:
        i.constraints.remove(c)

#Curve Generate
objectName = selection_names[0].basename.replace("SPIK", "Spline")
new_mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(objectName)
new_mesh.from_pydata(vertices, edges, [])
new_object = bpy.data.objects.new(objectName, new_mesh)
bpy.data.collections[Collection].objects.link(new_object)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
bpy.data.objects[objectName].select_set(state=True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active =  bpy.data.objects[objectName]
bpy.ops.object.convert(target='CURVE')
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
bpy.ops.curve.spline_type_set(type='NURBS')
bpy.context.object.data.splines[0].order_u = 3
bpy.context.object.data.splines[0].use_endpoint_u = True
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')

#Cons:Spline IK
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
bpy.data.objects[RigName].select_set(state=True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'POSE')
lastBone = selection_names[-1]
bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.bones.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName].pose.bones[lastBone.name].bone
bpy.ops.pose.constraint_add(type='SPLINE_IK')
bpy.context.object.pose.bones[lastBone.name].constraints["Spline IK"].chain_count = len(selection_names)
bpy.context.object.pose.bones[lastBone.name].constraints["Spline IK"].target = bpy.data.objects[objectName]
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='DESELECT')
Collections["SPIK"].is_solo = False

#Ctrl Bone Setup
Collections["SPIK_CTRL"].is_solo = True
newBoneName = objectName.replace("Spline","SPIK_CTRL")+'.001'
theBone = bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.edit_bones.new(newBoneName)
theBone.head = startingPt
theBone.tail = midPt
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'OBJECT')
bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.bones.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName].pose.bones[newBoneName].bone
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
bpy.context.active_bone.parent = bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.edit_bones[bpy.context.active_bone.basename.replace("SPIK_CTRL","Parent")]
bpy.context.active_bone.length = bpy.context.active_bone.length/4
bpy.ops.armature.duplicate_move(TRANSFORM_OT_translate={"value":diff})
bpy.ops.armature.duplicate_move(TRANSFORM_OT_translate={"value":diff})
bpy.ops.armature.select_all(action='SELECT')
Collections.active=Collections["SPIK_CTRL"]
bpy.ops.armature.collection_assign()
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='POSE')
for bone in bpy.context.selected_pose_bones:
    bone.custom_shape = custom_shape
    bone.color.palette = 'THEME09'
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
for bone in bpy.context.selected_editable_bones:
    bone.color.palette = 'THEME09'
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="POSE")


bpy.ops.pose.select_all(action='DESELECT')
Collections["SPIK_CTRL"].is_solo = False

#Cons:Copy Transforms
Collections["FK_Dress"].is_solo = True
for n in theList:
    bpy.data.objects[RigName].data.bones.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName].pose.bones[n].bone
    bpy.ops.pose.constraint_add(type='COPY_TRANSFORMS')
    Constraint_name = "CTRL:Copy Transforms-SPIK"
    bpy.context.object.pose.bones[n].constraints["Copy Transforms"].name = Constraint_name
    theCons = bpy.context.object.pose.bones[n].constraints[Constraint_name]
    theCons.target = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
    theCons.subtarget = n.replace("FK","SPIK")
    theCons.mix_mode = 'BEFORE'
    theCons.target_space = 'LOCAL'
    theCons.owner_space = 'LOCAL'
Collections["FK_Dress"].is_solo = False
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')

#Mod:Hooks
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
bpy.data.objects[objectName].select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = bpy.data.objects[objectName]
for x in range(3):
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_add(type='HOOK')
    hookName = f"Hook.00{x+1}"
    bpy.context.object.modifiers["Hook"].name = hookName
    if(x==0):
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode = 'EDIT')
        bpy.ops.curve.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        bpy.ops.curve.de_select_first()
    if(x==1):
        bpy.ops.curve.select_next()
        bpy.ops.curve.de_select_first()
    if(x==2):
        bpy.ops.curve.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        bpy.ops.curve.de_select_last()
    bpy.ops.object.hook_assign(modifier=hookName)
    bpy.context.object.modifiers[hookName].object = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
    boneName = bpy.data.objects[objectName].name.replace("Spline","SPIK_CTRL")+".00"+str(x+1)
    bpy.context.object.modifiers[hookName].subtarget = boneName
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
bpy.data.objects[RigName].select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = bpy.data.objects[RigName]
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='POSE')
